description: The project's data model as a Mermaid `erDiagram`: content-types (and, optionally, components) with their fields, one line per association (a bidirectional relation's two fields as one) with its cardinalities, media fields linked to the upload plugin's File, and the plugin types they link to. Read from the schemas, not from a running Strapi. Paste it in a README, a doc or an issue; `focus` narrows it to some types and their neighbours. With `strapiFields`, adds what Strapi gives every content-type (createdAt, updatedAt, publishedAt, createdBy/updatedBy → admin::user).

allPlugins.description: Every installed plugin type, not only those the project links to (default false).

focus.description: Only these UIDs and the types they link to.

from.description: A path inside the target project (e.g. the file you are editing). Disambiguates a multi-project workspace.

hideCustomFields.description: Leave out custom fields: true for all, or the custom-field names to leave out (e.g. a layout plugin's separators, listed under `customFields` in the answer). None by default: a custom field has a column like any other.

media.description: Media fields → the upload plugin's File (default true).

project.description: A project name (its folder) or root path. Use when you have no file path in hand.

strapiFields.description: The fields Strapi adds to every content-type (default false).

name: get_model_diagram
title: Data model diagram (Mermaid)
